name: LeadGen AI - Phase 6 End-to-End Automation Pipeline (Capture -> Gemini -> Gmail Delivery)

nodes.name: Google Sheets Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers on newly appended row in linked Google Form response spreadsheet. Do not hardcode credentials.

nodes.name: Save Generated Draft in FastAPI
nodes.notes: Persists generated draft in Draft status with idempotency duplicate protection

nodes.name: Gmail Dispatcher (Send Email)
nodes.notes: Sends personalized email through authenticated Gmail OAuth account

nodes.name: Record Delivery in FastAPI
nodes.notes: Atomically updates Lead and EmailRecord status in SQLite with idempotency lock

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Sent Success)
nodes.notes: Updates row with Email Status = Sent, Gmail Message ID, and Completed status

nodes.name: Google Sheets Update (Send Failed)
nodes.notes: Logs send failure safely without corrupting prospect data
